attributes.rule: A change from any other heading, except from [subheading 730120](/subheadings/7301200000-80).

A change from [subheading 730120](/subheadings/7301200000-80), whether or not there is also a change from any other heading, provided that the value of non-originating materials of [subheading 730120](/subheadings/7301200000-80) does not exceed **50%** of the transaction value or ex-works price of the product.
